invented.quote: The supply boat may not make it.
invented.why: The brief does not mention a supply boat as part of the game's setting or mechanics.

invented.quote: on an isolated rock. You'll share food and fuel, fix what the weather breaks, look after each other when someone gets sick or loses heart, and keep the light burning for the ships that depend on it.
invented.why: The brief only says you see a lighthouse keeper's family through a winter and does not mention an isolated rock or specific gameplay actions like sharing food and fuel, fixing things, or dealing with sickness and morale.
The brief says playtest sessions have run since 2023, not that the game itself was started in 2023.

invented.quote: friends, strangers, families, experienced gamers and people who had never played a co-op game before.
invented.why: The brief only says the game was playtested with about 60 different people and gives no details on who those people were or their gaming experience.

invented.quote: Every session changed something. The version you're backing has been reworked, rebalanced and simplified based on what those players showed me.
invented.why: The brief only gives the number of playtest sessions and does not state that every session changed something or that the game was reworked, rebalanced, and simplified.

invented.quote: where people sat down with strangers and played it start to finish.
invented.why: The brief only states that the designer took the game to two conventions, not what happened there or whether attendees played with strangers from start to finish.

invented.quote: More than **1,240 of you** signed up to hear about this launch.
invented.why: The brief states that 1,240 people signed up for the launch email, not more than 1,240.

invented.quote: I spend my days reading terrain and thinking about how people find their way through hard country. This game came from the same place.
invented.why: The brief only mentions that the creator works full time as a land surveyor and does not state what inspired the game.

invented.quote: that you can play with your partner, your kids or by yourself.
invented.why: The brief does not state the game's age suitability or that it can be played with kids.
